subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt and retarget the outside-repository closing PR, or sponsor a narrow same-repository fix in the current Anthropic transport/header paths?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the visible closing PR is outside the main repository and aimed at an older wrapper shape, so automation should not create a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor current-main fix
options.body: Create or approve a focused patch in the active Anthropic header-composition path with regression tests for direct OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

options.title: Adopt the fork work
options.body: Bring the fork work into the main repository, retarget it to the current transport implementation, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Wait on the fork
options.body: Leave this issue open until the fork author or a maintainer updates the closing PR into a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor current-main fix
recommendation.body: Create or approve a focused patch in the active Anthropic header-composition path with regression tests for direct OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent provider-header refactor history point most strongly to this area owner for choosing the landing path.
